main_text.p: ram istam, & ad habitatores eius, & ad o-mnes nationes istas per circuitum, & interficiam eos, ponamq; eos in stuporem & in sibilum, &c. cap.25.9.
2. [illegible, ~9 letters] Chaldaeos & eorum Regem Nebucadnezare, quos Dominus ipse describit, gentis, ingenij & finis qui ad bellum inferendū impulerat, metione facta.
Nomen Chasdim, Chaldaeos significat, quorum crebra in S. Biblijs mentio fit.

Si quis vestrum aliquid aliud cognoscere volet de eorū regione, metropoli, studijs, rebus gestis, cosulat Strabonem lib. 16. Geographiae: Plinium Natural.Hist. lib.6.cap.26.27. Pomp.Melam lib.3. de situ Orbis, cap. 8. Ioachimum Vadianū in Commentario de trib.partibus orbis terrarum, in titulo, de Chaldaea: Volaterranum lib.11.Geographiae: & Peucerum in Commentarij de generib.diuinationum ea parte, in qua de Chaldęorum religione, in sapientiam philosophicā transformata, differit, eamq; speciebus τῆς ἀστρονομίας[?] annumerat. pag.130.
De ingenijs Chaldaeorum infra plura dicentur. Hoc loco Gens amara & præceps uocantur. Tribuuntur illis duo, πνευ-

page.notes: Greek word after "2." is printed but not legible to me; left as illegible. Greek word in the Hebrew-name paragraph before "annumerat" is uncertain, marked [?]. Catchword at bottom right is only partly legible. Long s and printed f-forms normalised to s (e.g. "iftam", "ftuporem", "cofulat"). Final word "πνευ-" is hyphenated at line end as printed; the next word is the catchword.
